scripts.setup: py setup.py || python3 setup.py || python setup.py
scripts.rerun-setup: py setup.py || python3 setup.py || python setup.py
scripts.build: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:TEMP='D:\temp'; $env:TMP='D:\temp'; .\venv\Scripts\pip install pyinstaller; .\venv\Scripts\pyinstaller --noconsole --onedir --clean --distpath . --workpath D:/temp/build --collect-all customtkinter --add-data 'logo.png;.' --icon 'icon.ico' --name Adaptix_App main.py"
scripts.build-macos: pip install pyinstaller; pyinstaller --noconsole --onedir --clean --distpath . --collect-all customtkinter --add-data 'logo.png:.' --name Adaptix_App main.py
